Dushyant Bharadawaj

Gurgaon, Haryana, India

dushyantbhardwaj80@gmail.com

(91)9829499444

linkedin.com/in/dushyant-bharadawaj

SUMMARY

Data & Analytics professional with 10+ years of experience in data science, AI, and business strategy across financial and operational domains. Expertise in building ML models, LLM-driven solutions, and cloud-deployed analytics pipelines to enable data-backed decision-making. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, automation, and delivering business impact through Power BI and MLOps.

SKILLS



Statistical Modeling: Regression, Clustering, Forecasting, Market Basket Analysis.



Tools & Tech: Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, LangChain, Hugging Face, XGBoost, Isolation Forest), SQL, Power BI, Vector Databases.



Generative AI & LLMs: LLMs (GPT, Falcon), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings, Semantic Search.



Cloud Deployment: Azure ML.



Data Science Process: EDA, Feature Engineering, Model Development, Deployment, Monitoring, Explainability.



AI Microservices: API-based and Event-driven Architectures for scalable ML pipelines.

MLOps: CI/CD, Model Monitoring, Retraining, Responsible AI Practices.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

SENIOR ANALYST Accenture

December 2022 – Present



Developed dynamic dashboards for real-time audit insights, improving the speed and accuracy of decision-making and analyzed financial product performance and recommended optimization strategies for improved service offerings.



Designed and deployed customer segmentation models using KMeans and XGBoost to improve campaign targeting and increase ROI by 20%.



Implemented advanced anomaly detection techniques including Isolation Forest to identify early warning signals in fraud-prone scenarios, improving risk identification by 25%.



Led a team of analysts to deliver strategic data-driven solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives.



Collaborated with the GenAI team to fine-tune prompts and develop LLM-based solutions and Mentored junior analysts and led cross-functional project teams for AI/ML-driven decision-making.

SENIOR ASSOCIATE-DATA ANALYSIS Larsen and Toubro Construction

October 2021 - December 2022

• •

Built and deployed machine learning models for risk prediction and demand forecasting, improving procurement planning by 20%. Created robust ETL pipelines to handle large datasets, ensuring data accuracy and standardization for downstream analytics. Designed performance dashboards to monitor key KPIs across regions, enabling faster response to resource gaps.

JUNIOR ENGINEER(Data Analyst) Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (Govt. Of India)

July 2018 - September 2021



Conducted A/B testing and statistical analysis to optimize network reliability, reducing downtime by 15%.



Built forecasting models using time-series techniques to identify network congestion trends and improve service quality.



Automated reporting workflows using Python, reducing data preparation time by 30%.

BUSINESS ANALYST A&A Solutions

April 2015 - May 2018

Drafted Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD) to align technical solutions



with business goals. Conducted in-depth data analysis to identify operational inefficiencies, resulting in optimized workflows and improved decision- making processes.

CONSULTANT Geo Planet Solutions Pvt Limited

October 2013 - March 2015





Provided client support by troubleshooting and resolving configuration issues promptly, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum client satisfaction. Conducted feasibility studies and preliminary assessments for mining projects, evaluating technical and economic viability, and presenting findings to stakeholders to inform decision-making processes.

PROJECTS

Conversational AI Assistant using RAG







Objective: Designed and deployed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline integrating a Large Language Model with domain-specific knowledge for contextual responses. Technologies: Python, LangChain, Hugging Face, FAISS, Azure ML. Results: Reduced query response latency by 40% and improved accuracy of domain-specific answers by 35%.

AI Microservices Deployment



Objective: Built modular AI microservices for text summarization and NER, orchestrated through an event-driven architecture.



Technologies: Python (FastAPI), Docker, Azure Functions, Kafka, Hugging Face Transformers.



Results: Achieved scalable deployment and reduced model serving time by 50%.

AR Aging Dashboard



Objective: To design an AR (Accounts Receivable) aging dashboard that tracks key metrics, including trends, deductions, collections, and unapplied

cash, while identifying overdue accounts and payment patterns to improve cash flow.



Technologies: Python (Pandas, Matplotlib), SQL, Power BI.



Results: Reduced 30-day and above due accounts by 30% within six months. Developed detailed client payment profiles to analyze and predict

payment patterns from customer invoices. Improved overall cash flow by 20% through enhanced payment collection strategies.

Semantic Search Platform



Objective: Implemented a semantic search engine for financial document retrieval using embeddings and vector databases.



Technologies: Sentence Transformers, FAISS, PyTorch, Streamlit.



Results: Improved document retrieval relevance by 45%, enabling faster audit analysis and research.

SIGMA -ZI •

Objective: Deploy ML models to assess construction safety risks.



Technologies: Python (NLP, Time Series Forecasting), Docker, Kubernetes, Power BI.



Results: Enhanced prediction speed by 30% through containerized deployments.

Customer Segment Analysis and Recommendation •

Objective: Build a recommendation engine for customer retention.



Technologies: Python, PyTorch, Azure Data Factory.



Results: Boosted revenue by 10% through precise customer targeting.

Asset life cycle analysis •

Objective : Analysis of with the age of asset how the cost (IOM) increases and decides the best probable time to sell out the asset.



Technologies: R programming. GAM,ARIMA, Time Series Forecasting



Results: Able to sale/dispose assets on time reducing the financial loss .

EDUCATION

Master of Science in Machine Learning & AI Liverpool John Moores University Liverpool, England Expected Graduation: March’26

BACHELOR OF TECHNOLOGY Rajasthan Technical University Kota, Rajasthan Year : 2013

CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS



Google Data Analytics |Coursera | 2022



Azure AI Fundamentals |2024

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
SUMMARY
Data & Analytics professional with 10+ years of experience in data science, AI, and business strategy across financial and operational domains. Expertise in building ML models, LLM-driven solutions, and cloud-deployed analytics pipelines to enable data-backed decision-making. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, automation, and delivering business impact through Power BI and MLOps.
Objective: Designed and deployed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline integrating a Large Language Model with domain-specific knowledge for contextual responses. Technologies: Python, LangChain, Hugging Face, FAISS, Azure ML. Results: Reduced query response latency by 40% and improved accuracy of domain-specific answers by 35%.
AI Microservices Deployment

Objective: Built modular AI microservices for text summarization and NER, orchestrated through an event-driven architecture.

Technologies: Python (FastAPI), Docker, Azure Functions, Kafka, Hugging Face Transformers.

Results: Achieved scalable deployment and reduced model serving time by 50%.
AR Aging Dashboard

Objective: To design an AR (Accounts Receivable) aging dashboard that tracks key metrics, including trends, deductions, collections, and unapplied
cash, while identifying overdue accounts and payment patterns to improve cash flow.

Technologies: Python (Pandas, Matplotlib), SQL, Power BI.

Results: Reduced 30-day and above due accounts by 30% within six months. Developed detailed client payment profiles to analyze and predict
payment patterns from customer invoices. Improved overall cash flow by 20% through enhanced payment collection strategies.
Semantic Search Platform

Objective: Implemented a semantic search engine for financial document retrieval using embeddings and vector databases.

Technologies: Sentence Transformers, FAISS, PyTorch, Streamlit.

Results: Improved document retrieval relevance by 45%, enabling faster audit analysis and research.
SIGMA -ZI •
Objective: Deploy ML models to assess construction safety risks.

Technologies: Python (NLP, Time Series Forecasting), Docker, Kubernetes, Power BI.

Results: Enhanced prediction speed by 30% through containerized deployments.
Customer Segment Analysis and Recommendation •
Objective: Build a recommendation engine for customer retention.

Technologies: Python, PyTorch, Azure Data Factory.

Results: Boosted revenue by 10% through precise customer targeting.
Asset life cycle analysis •
Objective : Analysis of with the age of asset how the cost (IOM) increases and decides the best probable time to sell out the asset.

Technologies: R programming. GAM,ARIMA, Time Series Forecasting

Results: Able to sale/dispose assets on time reducing the financial loss .
